propositions: The current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy type-specific shape rather than enforcing author-guide leaf/container structural contracts, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections like Approach or grounded Scope.
clarity_score logic is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating drift risk when extending deterministic checks.

The current measure lacks deterministic verification that each Acceptance Criterion either bears [operator-attested] or contains an explicit proving clause (verified by, verify with, checked by) with actionable artifact or test reference.
Placeholder lexicon (TBD, figure out, verify whether, choose an appropriate X) defers decisions but is not mechanically detected or penalized in the clarity measure.
Required-section shape enforcement should key on graph altitude (leaf vs container) rather than ticket type, and count a heading only if it has nonblank content before the next H2.
Author-guide and authoritative G6 criteria conflict on rejected-alternative wording requirement, and Success Criteria naming persists in docs despite collapse into AC.
